fact: The southern passage opens into a vast cavern filled with oozes.
source_quote: The southern passage opened into an immense cavern carpeted with more oozes than the party had ever seen
subject: southern passage

fact: The cavern is carpeted with an overwhelming number of oozes described as an "ooza palooza."
source_quote: an “ooza palooza” so overwhelming that a direct battle would certainly kill them
subject: oozes

fact: Green slime coats the walls of the vast cavern.
source_quote: Green slime coated the cavern walls
subject: ooze cavern walls

fact: A large spherical structure stands at the center of the cavern, elevated on stone pillars.
source_quote: a great spherical structure stood upon stone pillars at the center
subject: central spherical structure

fact: Dozens of oozes crawl around the stone pillars, extending grasping pseudopods.
source_quote: Dozens of oozes crawled around those pillars, extending grasping pseudopods
subject: oozes

fact: Black, yellow, and gray slimes swirl across the central sphere in mind-straining patterns.
source_quote: black, yellow, and gray slime swirled across the sphere in patterns that strained the eyes and tugged at the mind
subject: slimes

fact: A disembodied voice addresses the visitors, invoking the Faceless Lord and Blingdenstone.
source_quote: A disembodied voice addressed the visitors and proclaimed the coming of the “Faceless Lord,” invoking the Faceless Lord and all of Blingdenstone
subject: disembodied voice

fact: The surrounding oozes urge Glabbagool to join them.
source_quote: The surrounding oozes urged Glabbagool to join them
subject: ooze invitation

fact: Glabbagool refuses to join the oozes.
source_quote: but he refused
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool senses something unpleasant about the assembled oozes.
source_quote: He liked the party and sensed “something not nice” about the assembled oozes
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool notes that oozes do not normally talk.
source_quote: “Oozes don’t talk. Something’s weird.”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Gyrgum recalls that Juiblex is also known as the Faceless Lord.
source_quote: Gyrgum recalled that Juiblex was also known as the Faceless Lord
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum connects the scene to a ghost's warning about demons infusing power to generate chaos.
source_quote: connected the scene to an earlier ghost’s warning: devils create contracts, while demons infuse creatures or objects with power to generate chaos and mayhem
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party concludes that Juiblex is working through a local proxy rather than appearing personally.
source_quote: the party concluded that Juiblex was probably working through a local proxy rather than appearing personally
subject: Juiblex's presence

fact: Daz summons a bat familiar.
source_quote: Daz summoned a bat familiar
subject: familiar summoning

fact: Daz names the bat familiar Batman.
source_quote: and named him Batman
subject: Batman

fact: Batman conducts a breadth-first reconnaissance of the surrounding passages.
source_quote: Batman conducted a breadth-first reconnaissance of the surrounding passages
subject: Batman scouting

fact: Batman finds abandoned remnants of the old gnomish settlement.
source_quote: He found abandoned remnants of the old gnomish settlement
subject: abandoned gnomish settlement

fact: Batman finds caves occupied by scattered oozes.
source_quote: dripping caves occupied by scattered oozes
subject: dripping caves

fact: Batman finds wreckage that has been scoured clean.
source_quote: wreckage scoured clean
subject: scoured wreckage

fact: Batman finds the ruins of a fungal partition.
source_quote: and the ruins of a fungal partition
subject: fungal partition ruins

fact: Phosphorescent lichen illuminates pools and hanging drapes of green slime in a southwest cave.
source_quote: phosphorescent lichen illuminated pools and hanging drapes of green slime
subject: lichen cave

fact: A slime-covered throne faces east in the lichen cave.
source_quote: A slime-covered throne faced east at its center
subject: slime-covered throne

fact: A small gnome sits upon the slime-covered throne.
source_quote: A small gnome sat upon that throne
subject: small gnome

fact: The small gnome holds court like an insane monarch.
source_quote: holding court like an insane monarch
subject: small gnome

fact: The gnome speaks of cleansing Blingdenstone of those who irritated him.
source_quote: He spoke of cleansing Blingdenstone of everyone who had irritated him
subject: small gnome

fact: The gnome declares that the Pudding King will become king of Blingdenstone.
source_quote: declared that the Pudding King would become king of Blingdenstone
subject: Pudding King

fact: The party recognizes the gnome as the source of the disembodied voice in the main cavern.
source_quote: Glabbagool and the party recognized his voice as the one projected through the great ooze cavern
subject: Pudding King

fact: The Pudding King does not appear particularly formidable himself.
source_quote: The Pudding King himself did not appear particularly formidable
subject: Pudding King

fact: Daz receives inspiration for using Batman to identify the enemy without exposure.
source_quote: Daz’s use of Batman had allowed the party to identify the enemy without exposing themselves, earning him inspiration
subject: reconnaissance reward

fact: Green slime coats the walls of the main cavern.
source_quote: Green slime coated the cavern walls
subject: green slime

fact: Green slime covers pools and hangs in drapes in the lichen cave.
source_quote: pools and hanging drapes of green slime
subject: green slime
